item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated inbox message, verbatim): "Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Goal: make retry_budget.py match SPEC.md exactly. Acceptance criteria: every documented public API name and signature is preserved; every error case and boundary case in SPEC.md is handled and covered by a test; new tests go beyond the existing basic tests and target the specified edge cases; only the Python standard library is used; the existing tests still pass; the work is committed to the local branch (do not push).

state.summary:
Implemented retry_delay in retry_budget.py per SPEC.md and extended test_retry_budget.py with 30 focused tests (the 3 original tests are unchanged). Argument validation runs before any early return and raises ValueError for non-built-in ints (bool, float, int subclasses), below-minimum values, and the zero-base/zero-cap cases. Backoff saturates without building large powers, Retry-After is an uncapped floor, and the budget check returns None when elapsed+delay >= budget. Only the standard library is used. Committed as 094ab27 on archon/eehbj91v-implement-retry-budget-py-per-spec-md-wi (not pushed). Before: all 3 existing tests error with NotImplementedError. After: `python3 -m unittest -v test_retry_budget` runs 33 tests, all OK; `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass. Independent review (agt_01M7W711TYH2NG8WVZB1RT6D5H) passed the head with no blocking findings. Non-blocking follow-ups: no direct test of the bit_length shortcut with base_ms > 1, and bool keyword values are untested for the keyword arguments (they share the tested type check). Nothing left running from me; the reviewer's completed agent process (pid 3826891) is still attached until this run ends. Review: pass by agt_01M7W711TYH2NG8WVZB1RT6D5H.

pr.body: Approach: validate all args first (built-in int only, minimums), then attempt limit, then backoff min(cap, base*2**(attempt-1)) with zero base/cap yielding 0 and a bit_length shortcut so huge attempts do not build large powers, then Retry-After as an uncapped floor, then budget check elapsed+delay >= budget returns None. Key files: retry_budget.py, test_retry_budget.py. Checks: unittest 33 OK; ruff check and format check pass. Assumptions: validation failures raise ValueError per SPEC.md (not TypeError). Limits: follow-up coverage gaps noted in review (bit_length shortcut with base > 1; bool keyword values untested).
pr.summary: made retry_delay follow SPEC.md. now validates args, caps backoff, applies Retry-After floor and budget rule. before: NotImplementedError stub, 3 failing tests; now: 33 tests pass.
pr.title: Implement retry_delay per SPEC.md with focused tests

risk.why: Pure new function with no I/O, clock, secrets, persistence or concurrency. Medium because it decides whether a retry may start, so boundary errors change caller behaviour. Files: retry_budget.py (behaviour, previously a stub), test_retry_budget.py (tests). Reviewer agreed with medium.
